text:
Mexico City yɛ Mexico capital na ɛyɛ capital a ɛdi kan wɔ Americas. Ne mfitiaseɛ kɔ Tenochtitlan, Mexica (Aztec) capital a wɔde too hɔ wɔ 1325 — da a ɛyɛ 13 March 1325, wɔhyehyɛɛ no wɔ 1925 sɛ kurow no mfeɛ 600. Wɔde too nsu a ɛwɔ Lake Texcoco mu, Tenochtitlan kɔɔ so yɛɛ kurow a ɛyɛ kɛseɛ wɔ pre-Columbian Americas mu na ɛyɛ Aztec Empire ti, kɔsi sɛ ɛhwee Hernán Cortés ne ne Tlaxcaltec allyfoɔ wɔ 1521. Spainfoɔ sane bɛyɛɛ kurow foforɔ no wɔ afe no mu wɔ nneɛma a ɛhwee no so. Ɛnnɛ ɛka nkurow a ɛyɛ kɛseɛ wɔ wiase nyinaa mu na ɛyɛ Mexico amanyɔ, amammerɛ ne sikasɛm ti, na ne stadium kɛseɛ no wɔ hɔ wɔ Tlalpan ne Coyoacán beaeɛ a ɛyɛ 2,200 m (7,220 ft) sorɔ.

Capital no yɛ Mexican football akoma. Ɛyɛ Club América — club a ɛyɛ nkonim ne a ɛyɛ kontroversial paa wɔ ɔman no mu — fie, na ɛyɛ El Tri fie nso, a wɔn qualifiers ne agorɔ a ɛyɛ kɛseɛ ma bowl no ma. Kurow no bɔ Clásico Capitalino, a ɛne América ne Cruz Azul ne Pumas, na ne arena kɛseɛ no abɔ football moment a ɛyɛ myth two: Pelé’s coronation wɔ 1970 ne Maradona’s double tia England wɔ 1986. Ɛne mframa a ɛyɛ hare wɔ 2,200 m ne nnipa a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔhwɛ wɔn fie no ma Mexico City yɛ beaeɛ a ɛyɛ hu paa wɔ wiase football mu.
